title: Zeus Agent Event
description: One normalized event. Every runtime is reduced to this shape before it reaches the gateway, the mobile app or the island. `kind` is canonical; `type` is the legacy alias still emitted by the Python hooks in adapters/, and the gateway folds one into the other.

event_id.description: Event id. Unique per session; a repeat is a replay and is ignored.

seq.description: Monotonic per session. The gateway drops an event whose seq is not greater than the last one it saw, which makes duplicate and out-of-order delivery harmless.

time.description: Unix milliseconds. Canonical for events from the desktop engine.

runtime.description: The CLI. Never the model vendor.

provider.description: Vendor behind the model. Kept separate from runtime.

type.description: Legacy alias for kind. Accepted for backwards compatibility with adapters that predate the closed set.

external_session_id.description: The runtime's own conversation id, needed to resume.

metadata.description: Runtime-specific detail, including `request_id` on an approval and `usage` on a terminal event.
